final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.throwing_hand, c.record_count, 1.0 * c.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM counts AS c JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.record_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.average_share) FROM shares AS s JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.average_share
